_: The curation. One entry = one specimen page under ui-kit/specimens/.
from     which source file the block comes from (kit.html by default).
section  the kit section id; label  the block heading, verbatim.
pick     optional: show only this element (or these comma-separated siblings)
out of the block, keeping its real ancestor chain. Without it the
unwrap   drop these wrappers from that chain. Used only for a tab panel,
which is display:none until a radio outside the component is checked.
wrap     false when the block already carries .device .app-case itself.
width    the viewport the specimen is shown at. Mobile-only pieces get 360,
so the media query shows them instead of being overridden. For a
control that sits on the bare canvas the width is the measured width
of the control itself, so the frame hugs it and no strip of empty
stone is left over. For anything on a plate the width keeps the
plate's own 20px padding, because that padding is the product.
component  the page it is canonical for; also  the pages that link to it.
Sections f-color and f-type are the token foundations and are shown on
tokens.html, so they are skipped here. No em dash.

block: Text input - default / hover / focus / disabled
skip_blocks.why: That block is stand markup: .kit-field, .kit-field-wrap, .kit-field-lbl, plus .is-hover and .is-focus classes hand-written to fake the pseudo-classes. It demonstrates no product class, so it cannot be the input specimen. The field the product ships is input-amount, sliced out of the Add funds dialog.
